verdict.rationale: Resend supports one-time scheduled sends (natural-language/ISO date) and mentions 'recurring flows with automations' for marketing contacts/broadcasts, but there's no dedicated general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduler beyond email sending, and the 'recurring flows' claim is only a single line reference with no detailed docs or hands-on evidence. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of recurring automation triggers/cadences, evidence of programmatic (API/MCP) control over recurrence, and independent confirmation the automations actually recur reliably.
